mapper.sql: ct.id, ct.course_id, ct.weekday, ct.start_period, ct.end_period, ct.start_week, ct.end_week, ct.room_id, c.course_code as courseCode, c.course_name as courseName, c.teacher_id as teacherId, c.term as term, c.max_student as maxStudent, t.teacher_name as teacherName, r.room_name as roomName, r.capacity as roomCapacity
from class_time ct join course c on ct.course_id = c.id left join teacher t on c.teacher_id = t.teacher_id left join room r on ct.room_id = r.id
mapper.select: select exists_ct.id, exists_ct.course_id, exists_ct.weekday, exists_ct.start_period, exists_ct.end_period, exists_ct.start_week, exists_ct.end_week, exists_ct.room_id, ec.course_code as courseCode, ec.course_name as courseName, ec.teacher_id as teacherId, ec.term as term, er.room_name as roomName from class_time candidate join course cc on candidate.course_id = cc.id join class_time exists_ct on exists_ct.weekday = candidate.weekday and exists_ct.start_period <= candidate.end_period and exists_ct.end_period >= candidate.start_period and exists_ct.start_week <= candidate.end_week and exists_ct.end_week >= candidate.start_week join course ec on exists_ct.course_id = ec.id and ec.term = cc.term join course_selection cs on cs.course_id = exists_ct.course_id and cs.student_id = #{studentId} left join room er on exists_ct.room_id = er.id where candidate.course_id = #{courseId} and exists_ct.course_id != candidate.course_id order by exists_ct.weekday, exists_ct.start_period
